objectives.summary: The project aims to develop an app for tracking and posting prayer walks online, with a goal to complete the app development by next summer. It envisions prayerwalking every street in the community monthly and includes a website to log routes and visualize community prayer coverage.

The app is expected to take about 3 months to develop and undergo initial debugging.
After initial debugging, another 3 months will be needed for thorough debugging through actual trials.
An Android app will be available shortly after the iPhone app.
The website www.prayerwalking.ca was created to log prayerwalking routes and allows users to see what part of their community has been prayed through.
